note: EIP-7939 gating: the caller runs at Prague and CALLs a callee whose code is `PUSH32 0; CLZ; PUSH1 1; SSTORE`. Below Osaka 0x1e is undefined, so the callee's frame aborts and writes nothing; the CALL returns no data and the caller's own frame survives -- both numbers recorded in `source`.

source.why: Both numbers measured before the case was written. The expected slots are the Prague row; the Osaka row on the Oracle is the discriminating half -- a tool that executes 0x1e at Prague writes slot 0 of the callee and returns 0x20 of return data, reports `0x1` in the caller's slot 1, and fails this case.
